title: Evolution and Spread of SARS-CoV-2
teaser: Interactive webinar on the evolution and spread of SARS-CoV-2, jointly organised by JBNSTS and tAcT. Speaker: Prof. Partha Pratim Majumder. Over 105 participants attended.
homepageMatter: On 7 July 2020, tAcT and JBNSTS (Jagadis Bose National Science Talent Search) jointly conducted an interactive webinar on the evolution and spread of SARS-CoV-2. Prof. Partha Pratim Majumder spoke to more than 105 participants, with a wide-ranging Q&A session that extended the event by nearly an hour.
